text.en:
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Franchise (Forms and Fees)
Regulations 1999.

 (2) These Regulations come into operation on 8 October 1999.

Forms

2. (1) For the purpose of the provisions of the Act on form as may be
determined by the Registrar, such form shall be as may be determined
by the Registrar from time to time.

 (2) For the purpose of the provisions of the Act on prescribed form,
such form as specified in the First Schedule the contents of which are
specified in the Second Schedule shall be used.

Direction in forms

3. The prescribed forms shall be completed in accordance with the
directions specified in the forms.

6       Laws of Malaysia P.U. (A) 422/1999

Additional information

4. Where a prescribed form requires completion by the attachment to
the form of a document containing particulars or other matters referred
to in the form, those particulars or other matters are prescribed as the
additional information or documents required under the provisions of
the Act.

Verification of copies

5. A copy of any document required to be attached to a prescribed form
shall be verified by statutory declaration declaring that the copy ha s
been compared with the original document and that it is a true copy of
the original document.

Annexure accompanying forms

6. (1) Where the space provided for a particular purpose in a
prescribed form is insufficient to contain all the required information in
relation to a particular item, that information s hall be set out in an
annexure.

 (2) An annexure to a prescribed form shall be signed by each
applicant signing the form to which the annexure is made.

Fees

7. (1) The fees payable under the Act are as prescribed in the
Third Schedule.

 (2) The prescribed fee payable for or in respect of an act required to
be done under the Act shall be paid at the time the act is done.

 (3) Where a fee is payable for or is in respect of an act required to be
done under the Act and the act is done without payment of the fee, the
act is deemed not to have been done until the fee has been paid.

                   Franchise (Forms And Fees) Regulations 1999                 7
